observed_errors.title: CLI Main Scope Local sys and timedelta Variable Shadowing
observed_errors.symptom: cannot access local variable 'sys' where it is not associated with a value / cannot access local variable 'timedelta'
observed_errors.reproduction_command: uv run python -m pytest tests/test_cli.py -k test_status_command --no-cov
observed_errors.qa_test_directive: Add test_exception_handler_uses_unshadowed_sys verifying sys.stderr write on exception and test_plan_week_default_date_uses_unshadowed_timedelta.

observed_errors.title: Event Store Replay Non-Deterministic UUID String Tie-Breaker
observed_errors.symptom: list_after_event returns empty list due to random UUID string comparison on identical timestamps
observed_errors.qa_test_directive: Add test_list_after_event_identical_timestamps_deterministic enforcing rowid sorting on events with identical timestamps and inverted UUID strings.

observed_errors.title: Issue Runner Subprocess Spawns POSIX bash on Windows Hosts
observed_errors.symptom: [WinError 1920] The file cannot be accessed by the system when invoking subprocess with bash on Windows
observed_errors.qa_test_directive: Parametrize test_issue_runner.py to inspect sys.platform and use powershell.exe or mock bash execution when bash executable is absent on PATH.

observed_errors.title: Notification SSE Server IPv6 Localhost Socket Connect Denial
observed_errors.symptom: [WinError 10013] An attempt was made to access a socket in a way forbidden by its access permissions
observed_errors.reproduction_command: uv run python -m pytest tests/test_notification_streaming.py -k test_server_health_endpoint --no-cov
observed_errors.qa_test_directive: Update _local_sockets_available in test_notification_streaming.py to verify socket connect() to 127.0.0.1 and replace localhost with 127.0.0.1 in HTTPConnection calls.

observed_errors.title: Brief Generator Fallback Leaks ReviewStatus String into Recommended Formats
observed_errors.symptom: Brief fallback sets recommended_formats=['needs_review'], causing downstream manifest builder to warn on unknown format and fallback to short_video
observed_errors.qa_test_directive: Add test_fallback_brief_does_not_contain_review_status_values asserting recommended_formats only contains valid AssetType format strings or empty list.

observed_errors.title: Non-Atomic 0-Byte Storyboard JSON Write Triggers JSONDecodeError in Asset Generation
observed_errors.symptom: Failed to load Storyboard <topic_id>.json: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0), causing AssetGenerationService to skip asset generation
observed_errors.reproduction_command: uv run python -c "from pathlib import Path; p = Path('data/storyboards/test.json'); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); p.write_text(''); from content_creation.storage.local import LocalStorage; s = LocalStorage(Path('.')); print(s.get_storyboard('test'))"
observed_errors.qa_test_directive: Add test_load_storyboard_handles_empty_or_truncated_file verifying that 0-byte or corrupted JSON files trigger defensive handling or clean error logging without aborting asset generation.

observed_errors.title: Scoring Component Float Rounding Drift Violates Score Consistency Invariant
observed_errors.symptom: Score inconsistency: priority_score (65.75) != sum of components (65.76) flagged across multiple scored topics
evidence_sources: Live pipeline smoke test: score-topics validation log
observed_errors.reproduction_command: uv run python -c "from content_creation.scoring.engine import ScoringEngine; from content_creation.scoring.config import ScoringConfig; from content_creation.models.topic import TopicItem; t = TopicItem(id='test', title='Test topic', url='https://example.com', source='arxiv', category='paper', raw_text='A '*100); e = ScoringEngine(ScoringConfig()); scored = e.score_item(t); print('priority:', scored.priority_score, 'sum:', sum([scored.student_usefulness_score, scored.novelty_score, scored.credibility_score, scored.explainability_score, scored.hook_potential_score]))"
observed_errors.qa_test_directive: Add test_scoring_float_consistency asserting priority_score strictly equals the sum of rounded component scores across 100 randomized topic payloads.

observed_errors.title: Teaser RSS Feed Items Discarded Prematurely by Insufficient Text Filter
observed_errors.symptom: 290 out of 2048 topics rejected as insufficient_text when raw_text < 100 chars, discarding flagship posts (GPT-4o System Card, Introducing OpenAI o1)
evidence_sources: Live pipeline smoke test: score-topics execution summary
observed_errors.reproduction_command: uv run python -c "from content_creation.scoring.engine import ScoringEngine; from content_creation.scoring.config import ScoringConfig; from content_creation.models.topic import TopicItem; t = TopicItem(id='test', title='Introducing OpenAI o1', url='https://openai.com/index/o1', source='openai', category='release', raw_text='Short teaser'); e = ScoringEngine(ScoringConfig()); res = e.score_items([t]); print(res['rejected'][0].rejection_reason)"
observed_errors.qa_test_directive: Add test_short_teaser_flagged_for_enrichment asserting that topics with short raw_text but high-credibility sources trigger an enrichment fetch rather than immediate rejection.

observed_errors.title: CLI Subcommand Drift vs Documentation for Content Intelligence and Storyboards
observed_errors.symptom: cli.py: error: argument command: invalid choice: 'generate-ci' / 'generate-storyboards' when following README.md operational instructions
observed_errors.qa_test_directive: Add test_cli_subcommands_match_readme verifying every documented CLI command in README.md is a registered parser in cli.py returning exit code 0 or 2 (valid argument parsing).

observed_errors.title: AppContainer Sandbox Permission Denial on Storage Directory Writeability Probe
observed_errors.symptom: PermissionError: [WinError 13] Access is denied: '[USER_HOME]/.../.write_test_*' during LocalStorage initialization under AppContainer sandbox
evidence_sources: Live pytest sweep within AppContainer sandbox
observed_errors.qa_test_directive: Update LocalStorage._verify_writeable to probe data/ subdirectory rather than workspace root, avoiding AppContainer ACL permission blocks on root.

observed_errors.title: Non-UTF-8 CP1252 Smart Quotes in Staged Feed JSON Files Trigger Decoding Warnings
observed_errors.symptom: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x97 in position 360: invalid start byte logged when cli status inspects 1519 staged JSON files
observed_errors.qa_test_directive: Add test_read_staged_json_handles_cp1252_encoding asserting LocalStorage._read_json safely decodes non-UTF8 smart quotes using errors='replace'.

observed_errors.title: CLI Monolithic Main Function Variable Scope Collisions Under Strict Typing
observed_errors.symptom: 127 errors in 1 file (checked 1 source file) in cli.py due to repeated re-assignment of local variable names across 32 subcommand branches
observed_errors.qa_test_directive: Add CI ratchet test enforcing mypy error count on cli.py does not exceed 127 and decreases as subcommand blocks are decomposed into separate modules.

anticipated_risks.title: Live LLM Provider Quota Exhaustion & Rate Limits
anticipated_risks.risk_description: High-concurrency generation bursts without rate-limiting delays trigger HTTP 429 quota exhaustion on Gemini API endpoints.
anticipated_risks.qa_test_directive: Mock 429 response from GeminiProvider and assert failover to OpenRouter without pipeline abort.

anticipated_risks.title: Malformed Markdown Code Fences in LLM Synthesis Outputs
anticipated_risks.risk_description: LLM outputting JSON wrapped in markdown fences (```json ... ```) or conversational commentary triggers json.JSONDecodeError in generator parsing.
anticipated_risks.qa_test_directive: Test ContentIntelligenceGenerator and StoryboardGenerator against synthetic responses containing markdown fences, trailing commentary, and unescaped quotes.

anticipated_risks.title: Unchecked API Token Budget Consumption During High-Volume Batches
anticipated_risks.risk_description: Uncapped multi-format asset generation across large topic batches exhausts account token budgets mid-run, aborting downstream stages.
anticipated_risks.qa_test_directive: Implement pre-flight token budget validator in AssetGenerationService that calculates estimated batch cost and aborts before LLM dispatch.

anticipated_risks.title: In-Memory Event Bus Isolation Across Worker Daemon Subprocesses
anticipated_risks.risk_description: Process-bound singleton _EVENT_BUS in background worker processes drops event delivery to UI subscriber threads and SSE streaming server.
anticipated_risks.qa_test_directive: Add test verifying background job completion events are persisted to SQLiteEventRepository and picked up by main process SSE subscribers.

anticipated_risks.title: POSIX Signal Handling Incompatibility in Windows Background Worker Daemon
anticipated_risks.risk_description: Signal handlers using SIGTERM or SIGQUIT fail on Windows OS process termination, leaving stale resource locks in data/jobs.db.
anticipated_risks.qa_test_directive: Test WorkerDaemon graceful shutdown under Windows console termination events and verify LockManager releases all held locks on process exit.
